title: Symrise wins worldwide L’Oréal Energy Award for circular hydrogen recycling that advances decarbonization in cosmetics
summary: – L'Oréal honors "Closing the Hydrogen Loop" as a pioneering circular production model – Reduces fresh hydrogen demand by around 80% and improves process efficiency at scale – Supports reliable supply and lower carbon intensity for everyday cosmetic applications

extraction.key_fact: 심라이즈가 화장품 분야의 탈탄소화를 진전시키는 순환형 수소 재활용 모델로 로레알 에너지 어워드를 수상했다.
